{{Quote|I'm just a pubtender, I don't want any trouble.|[[Crimson Redrum]]'s [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]]|<ref name="ss" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Amani/Legends|Amani]] '''bartender''' worked on the [[Crimson Redrum]], one of the barrooms of the [[Quarek'k]], a large bar complex located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shortly after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ss" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] visited the bar, searching for information regarding the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]]. Sing sought help from the Crimson Redrum [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]], who then directed her to his colleague [[Calathi]], a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] working on the [[Green Dystopia]], another barroom of the Quarek'k.<ref name="ss" />
